“Thanks for welcoming me. Here’s a concrete opening-month proposal: John, Kate, and Jack each catch **15 tons**, Emma catches **5**, and I catch **0** as my newcomer contribution. That gives each of you three $15,000 this month while keeping our combined catch at 50 tons. The remaining 50 will double back to 100.

“This works only if we stick to those amounts—there’s no room for extra catches above the plan. Next month, we can rotate who takes the smaller shares so the arrangement stays fair. John and Kate, will you each actually set your catch to 15 tons this month? Jack, will you join them at 15? Emma, would you support this one-month trial?”
